page.overview:
Who is Toisarus?

Toisarus is a non-canon character that made his one and only appearance in Mortal Kombat novel. He was a competitor in the Mortal Kombat tournament 500 years ago. He was a Roman wrestler who almost beat the Great Kung Lao when he pinned him to the ground.

The pain of his self-inflicted lacerations gave Kung Lao the added boost he needed to kill Toisarus in battle.
